title: Iyer Ips
desc: A deputy commissioner strives to establish justice by any means necessary. However, trouble arises when a gangster vows to kill him.

title: Solaikuyil
desc: Maruthu arrives in Mulimalai, claiming kinship to a respected figure, but the village guard, Maayandi, is suspicious. Soon, a murder investigation raises questions about Maruthu's identity.

title: Senathipathi
desc: Sethupathi, a young man, falls in love with Lingappan Naicker, the village head's daughter Aishwarya. Meanwhile, the girl's father asks Senathipathi, Sethu's older brother, to protect her.

title: Manandhal Mahadevan
desc: After returning from the States, Raja receives a marriage proposal from a wealthy family. Accompanied by his driver, Mahadevan, Raja meets the bride, but Mahadevan ends up getting married to her.

title: Selva
desc: Selva becomes friends with Kamini, a minister's daughter. However, when she gets kidnapped by a terrorist group, he strives to rescue her.
